subject: Urgent: Novus AI renewal — concession authorization needed
messages:
From: Samantha Ng <samantha@novus.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novus AI Procurement <procure@novus.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal proposal — pricing request and SLA

Connor —

Thanks for the renewal draft. We reviewed with the exec team and procurement. Two things stand out as blockers for us to proceed:

- Price: we need a net-effective reduction of ~30% versus this year's run-rate to fit into our FY28 budget.
- SLA & term: our customers require a contractual 99.95% monthly availability and a 6-month term reset (we run quarterly budgets and can commit to a 6-month volume target).

If Redwood can provide a one-time credit and the SLA add-on (with liability limited to credits) we can sign as early as Friday. If not, we will have to evaluate alternate vendors for this workload.

I've attached our PO template for reference.

Thanks —
Samantha
Head of Platform Ops
Novus AI
[Attachment: novus_po_draft.pdf (PDF)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal proposal — pricing request and SLA (Novus AI)

Team —

Looping you on Novus AI's ask. Quick summary:
- ARR at stake: ~USD 650k (current year footprint, expectation to grow)
- Customer requests: 30% net reduction, 6-month term reset, 99.95% SLA contractually added
- Timeline: they want to sign by this Friday EOD

What I recommend as a negotiable package to avoid churn:
1) One-time invoice credit equal to 20% of one quarter's run-rate (not an ongoing discount) — reduces near-term cost but preserves effective price later
2) Add 99.95% SLA as an optional add-on for the renewal term with a clearly capped credit formula (no change to MSA liability beyond credits)
3) Approve a 6-month term reset conditional on explicit volume targets and a short addendum to the MSA handled by Legal

I've attached the pricing breakdown and the customer's PO. Need an approval (or alternative) from finance/exec for the credit band and SLA add-on. If approved, I'll send a redlined term sheet to Procurement and loop Legal/CSM.

Attachments: pricing_summary.xlsx, novus_po_draft.pdf

Connor
Enterprise AE — Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal proposal — pricing request and SLA (Novus AI)

Connor — thanks for the clear summary. My initial read: high retention risk if we don't move. Approve the approach with constraints:

- One-time credit: authorize up to 25% of one quarter's bill as a one-time credit (must be invoiced as credit, not percent off list)
- SLA: approve adding a 99.95% SLA addendum for the renewal term, with credits limited to monthly usage credits per our standard SLA schedule. Legal must draft the addendum.
- Term reset: approve 6-month reset but only if Novus signs a binding volume commitment tied to a monitoring cadence with CSM.

Please prepare a short concession_term_sheet.pdf with the above language and include a recovery clause (if volume commitments are missed, credits recouped pro-rata). Send to Legal + Procurement for redline. Vivek — flagging for final exec sign-off on the credit cap.

Marissa
Head of Sales, Enterprise

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 16:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal proposal — pricing request and SLA (Novus AI)

Marissa / Connor —

Approve on the terms Marissa outlined. Conditions:
1) Credit is one-time, capped at 25% of one quarter's bill (document amount in concession_term_sheet.pdf). No baseline price change after renewal.
2) SLA addendum limited to credit-only remedies (no expanded indemnities). Legal to confirm language; do not sign until Legal signs off.
3) Term reset to 6 months accepted only with an attached volume commitment schedule and CSM quarterly review; sales ops to track.
4) Require Deal Desk to generate an internal approval code for accounting and sales comp (AUTH-RDW-9821-EXC).

Connor — proceed to send the concession sheet to Novus Procurement and copy Legal and CSM. Once Procurement returns the signed PO with the concession addendum, Finance will issue the credit per accounting process.

Vivek
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: concession_term_sheet.pdf (PDF)]
